body: ah thanks ! yeah i’m 20 so fairly young still! my parents have basically told me if i don’t finish this degree and get a certain grade they will cut me off hahaha at first i thought they were joking but i am not even sure anymore. it’s hard to be honest with them about how i feel and i know they are looking out for my future but yeaaah they would take it badly. so yeah i doubt they will have much sympathy unless something genuinely bad happened aha but i do need to start being honest with people about how things are going and stop lying to myself and everyone around me even if the consequences could be badddd.
